description: Every valuation satisfying the elimination of \(p\) from \(\Gamma\) extends to a valuation satisfying \(\Gamma\) that agrees with it at every atom other than \(p\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.elimination_extend.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (p : α)
  (Γ : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.ClauseSet α) (v : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Valuation α)
  (h : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.Models v (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.eliminate p Γ)) :
  ∃ w, Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.Models w Γ ∧ ∀ (q : α), q ≠ p → w q = v q
